evaluation.reason: No independent labeled gesture ground truth, speaker review, or learned conditional-person policy is available.

limitations: Source-context lexical retrieval selects measured geometry; it is not a learned personal gesture policy.
Unsupervised geometry cluster IDs are not emotion, intention, or personality labels.
The motion-validation event is excluded from normalization, feature selection, prototypes, thresholds, and runtime retrieval.
Frames from one event are correlated; primitive count is not a count of independent people or events.
Geometry-preview windows have no reviewed association between the image track and the named speaker.
Direction-only limb/finger measurements omit axial twist and occluded joints; monocular estimates are not ground-truth motion capture.
A training distance envelope is a descriptive range, not a calibrated confidence interval.
